meaning: 社會道德淪喪；無規範狀態

The monumental temples of Mediterranean antiquity demonstrate highly refined architectural and geometric skill. (地中海古代的宏偉神廟，展現了高度精緻的建築和幾何技巧。)
Agrarian farmers anxiously tracked atmospheric airflow anomalies, hoping to forecast the onset of seasonal rain drops. (農業農民焦慮地追蹤大氣氣流異常，希望能預測季節性降雨的開始。)
The industrialization of textile piecework manufacturing proceeded apace throughout the centralized metropolitan factory sectors. (在中央集權的大都會工業區中，紡織業計件生產迅速發展。)
The centralized chiefdom elite allocated two hectares apiece to sedentary families to stabilize agriculture taxes. (中央集權的酋邦菁英分配給每戶定居家庭兩公頃土地，以穩定農業稅收。)
The old Appalachian mountains have been significantly flattened over geologic eras by relentless wind and water erosion. (古老的阿帕拉契山脈歷經地質年代的風雨侵蝕，山勢已顯著降低。)

The exquisite artistry of the silversmith was displayed in the flawless geometric symmetry of the ceremonial chalice. (銀匠精湛的藝術技巧，展現在儀式用聖杯無瑕的幾何對稱中。)

Human memory operates largely through an associative network where sensory inputs trigger related recollections. (人類記憶在很大程度上是透過聯想網路運作的，感官輸入會引發相關的回憶。)

The marketing team designed the product packaging attractively to capture the attention of retail consumers. (行銷團隊將產品包裝設計得非常有吸引力，以捕捉零售消費者的注意力。)

meaning: 自律神經的；自動調節的

A sudden winter avalanche flowing along the steep alpine mountain slopes can completely reshape the local timberline ecosystem. (沿著陡峭高山山坡流下的突然冬季雪崩，會完全重塑當地的林木線生態系統。)
The avant-garde impressionist movement initially faced severe skepticism from traditional aristocratic art critics. (前衛的印象派運動最初面臨了來自傳統貴族藝術評論家的嚴厲質疑。)
Early aerodynamic scientists analyzed the wing profiles of predatory birds to design functional setups for the human aviator. (早期空氣動力學研究者分析掠食性鳥類的翼型，為人類飛行員設計實用機翼。)
Climatologists argue that topsoil salinization is an avoidable catastrophe if overirrigation constants are strictly legally regulated. (氣候學家認為，只要嚴格依法管制過度灌溉，就能避免表土鹽化這場災害。)
Early Conestoga wagons moved awkwardly across the uneven prairie marshlands, slowing travel. (早期的科內斯托加篷車笨拙地駛過高低不平的大草原沼澤地，拖慢了行程。)

meaning: 牙牙學語、胡言亂語、潺潺聲
example: The infant began to babble happily, exploring phonetic sounds before producing clear words. (嬰兒開始快樂地牙牙學語，在發出清晰的單字之前探索著語音。)
The ancient Babylonian astronomers maintained systematic tablets to chart the periodic cycles of Jupiter and Venus. (古代巴比倫天文學家保存了系統化的泥板，以繪製木星與金星的週期性循環圖表。)
The rugged sandstone cliffs of the southwestern canyon provided a defensive architectural backdrop for ancestral pueblo dwellings. (美國西南部峽谷崎嶇的砂岩峭壁，構成祖先普韋布洛人居所的天然防禦屏障。)
The professional tennis player practiced her powerful backhand stroke to prepare for the championship match. (這位職業網球選手練習了她強有力的反手擊球，為冠軍賽做準備。)
Bacterial decomposition in anaerobic wetlands releases heavy quantities of volatile methane gas into the atmosphere. (厭氧濕地中的細菌分解作用會向大氣中釋放大量的揮發性甲烷氣體。)
A specialized anaerobic bacterium can survive deep inside oceanic rifts where oxygen is completely absent. (一種特化的厭氧細菌可以在氧氣完全缺乏的海洋裂谷深處存活下來。)
For breakfast, she enjoyed a toasted cinnamon bagel topped with a generous layer of organic cream cheese. (早餐時，她享用了一個烤過的肉桂貝果，上面抹了厚厚一層有機奶油乳酪。)
The conservative investors tended to balk at funding technology startups that lacked a proven revenue model. (保守的投資人往往對資助缺乏成熟營利模式的科技新創公司感到畏縮不前。)
The preindustrial minstrel performed a historical ballad inside the urban arcade marketplace to entertain working-class dealers. (工業化前的吟遊詩人在城市拱廊市場演唱歷史民謠，娛樂工人階級的小商販。)
Spending a peaceful weekend alone in nature acted as a soothing balm for his severely stressed mind. (獨自在自然中度過一個平靜的週末，對他承受巨大壓力的心靈起到了舒緩的撫慰作用。)
The traditional herbalist utilized distilled balsam to formulate a soothing ointment for skin irritations. (傳統草藥醫生利用蒸餾香脂，調配出一種用於緩解皮膚過敏的舒緩軟膏。)
The barb on a bird's feather locks adjacent filaments together, forming a uniform surface for flight. (鳥類羽毛上的倒鉤將相鄰的羽絲鎖在一起，形成一個用於飛行的均勻表面。)
The archaic text fragment records a song written by an ancient Celtic bard, celebrating the chiefdom's victory. (這段古老文字記載了一首由古代凱爾特吟遊詩人創作的歌曲，歌頌酋邦的勝利。)
The historical winery produced a barrelful of artisanal vinegar using traditional aging techniques. (這家歷史悠久的酒莊使用傳統的陳釀技術，生產了整整一桶的手工醋。)
Oceanic crustal formations are chiefly composed of dense, dark basalt extruded from mid-ocean volcanic rifts. (海洋地殼構造主要由從中洋脊火山裂谷噴出的緻密、黑暗玄武岩組成。)
The thin oceanic crust is dominated by dense, dark, crystalline basaltic rock formations extruded from mantle fractures. (薄薄的海洋地殼主要由從地函裂縫噴出的玄武岩構成，岩石緻密、色澤深且結晶明顯。)
Ectothermic marine reptiles like the prehistoric ichthyosaur had to bask near warm equatorial surface ocean waters. (像史前魚龍這樣的外溫海洋爬蟲類，必須在溫暖的赤道表面海洋水域附近曬太陽。)
Handcraft basketmaking was a prominent Neolithic speciality, utilizing woven wetland reed filaments to store acorns and grain surpluses. (編籃是新石器時代重要的專門工藝，人們利用編織的濕地蘆葦儲存橡實與剩餘穀物。)
Ancestral pueblo communities excelled in handcraft basketry, using woven wetland reed stalks to manufacture dry storage urns. (祖先普韋布洛人擅長編籃，使用編織的濕地蘆葦製作乾燥物品的儲藏甕。)

meaning: 籃筐編織工藝；籃筐製品
example: Ancestral Pueblo communities excelled in basketwork, weaving dried wetland reeds into storage vessels. (祖先普韋布洛人擅長編籃，把乾燥的濕地蘆葦編成儲藏容器。)
The ancient Roman metropolis featured expansive public bathhouse architecture that served as a center for social gathering. (古羅馬大都市以廣闊的公共浴室建築為特色，該建築充當社交聚集的中心。)
Centralized industrial efforts in the nineteenth century led to the manufacture of iron-hulled, steam-powered battleships. (十九世紀工業集中化的發展，促成了鐵殼蒸汽動力戰艦的製造。)
The coastal beacon provided crucial navigational guidance to maritime vessels during dense winter fogs. (在密集的冬霧中，海岸燈塔為海上船隻提供了至關重要的導航指引。)
The chef attached a heavy metal beater to the industrial mixer to prepare the dense bread dough. (主廚將一個重金屬攪拌器安裝到工業攪拌機上，以準備濃稠的麵包麵團。)
The beaver acts as an ecosystem engineer by constructing dams that create rich wetland habitats. (河狸藉由建造水壩創造豐富的濕地棲地，扮演著生態系統工程師的角色。)
A thick bedcover of fine volcanic ash completely enclosed the ancient metropolis, preserving structural masonry walls perfectly. (一層厚厚的細火山灰完全覆蓋這座古代都市，並將石造牆體保存得十分完好。)
Trust and mutual respect form the absolute bedrock of any long-lasting international diplomatic alliance. (信任與相互尊重構成了任何持久國際外交聯盟的絕對基石。)
The grand, monumental architecture of the Mediterranean citadel was explicitly designed to befit an elite aristocrat. (地中海城堡宏偉、不朽的建築被明確設計，以與一位精英貴族的身份相稱。)
The pioneer homesteader worked to befriend nearby sedentary pueblo communities to exchange agricultural foodstuffs during winter. (拓荒農莊主試圖與附近的定居普韋布洛人社群建立友誼，以便在冬季交換農產品。)
Behaviorism focuses on observable actions rather than internal mental states. (行為主義專注於可觀察的行為，而不是內部的心理狀態。)

meaning: 行為主義者、行為主義的
example: The psychology professor presented a comprehensive critique of behaviorist theories regarding language acquisition. (心理學教授對關於語言習得的行為主義理論，提出了全面的批判。)

meaning: 美女、（某地或某場合的）最迷人的女性
example: The southern heiress was recognized as the reigning belle of the annual charity ball. (這位南方女繼承人被公認為年度慈善舞會上最迷人的女性。)
The male bovine ruminant will bellow loudly across the steppe prairies to coordinate group movement and ward off predators. (公牛會在大草原上高聲吼叫，以協調群體移動並嚇阻掠食者。)
The traditional blacksmith used a large leather bellows to pump oxygen into the forge, intensifying the fire. (傳統鐵匠使用大型皮革風箱向鍛爐輸送氧氣，以增強火勢。)
Realist writers often bemoaned the hazardous urban conditions caused by rapid industrialization and centralized factory rules. (寫實主義作家經常哀嘆，快速工業化與中央集權的工廠規範造成危險的都市環境。)
The modern welfare state aims to create a beneficent system that supports marginalized and impoverished citizens. (現代福利國家旨在建立一個支持邊緣化與貧困公民的仁慈福利制度。)
The mercantile corporate elite tier was the principal economic beneficiary of private turnpike transit tariff monopolies. (商業企業菁英是民營收費公路交通費壟斷的主要經濟受益者。)
The museum was built using generous donations from a benevolent billionaire. (這座博物館是利用一位仁慈的億萬富翁的慷慨捐款建造的。)
The biopsy confirmed that the tumor discovered during the routine examination was entirely benign. (切片檢查證實，在例行檢查中發現的腫瘤完全是良性的。)
The wealthy art collector decided to bequeath his entire collection of Renaissance paintings to the national museum. (這位富有的藝術收藏家決定將他所有的文藝復興時期畫作遺贈給國家博物館。)
During the last ice age, Beringia emerged as a wide land bridge permitting hominid migration into North America. (在最後一次冰河時期，白令陸橋顯現為一座寬闊的陸橋，容許原始人類遷移進入北美洲。)
The university decided to bestow an honorary doctorate upon the world-renowned human rights activist. (這所大學決定將榮譽博士學位授予這位世界聞名的人權運動家。)
The United States Congress is a bicameral legislature consisting of two houses. (美國國會是由兩院組成的兩院制立法機構。)
Early optical craftspeople engineered bifocal lenses to correct both near and distant vision. (早期的光學工匠設計出雙焦距鏡片，同時矯正近視與遠視。)
Cognitive studies indicate that early childhood bilingualism can significantly improve working memory and executive control. (認知研究表明，幼兒時期的雙語能力可以顯著提高工作記憶與執行控制能力。)
Computers process data using a binary system consisting exclusively of ones and zeros. (電腦使用完全由一和零組成的二進位系統來處理資料。)
The laboratory specialized in analyzing the complex biochemical reactions that occur during human digestion. (該實驗室專門分析人類消化過程中發生的複雜生物化學反應。)
The preservation of tropical rainforests is critical because they contain a vast portion of the earth's biodiversity. (保護熱帶雨林至關重要，因為它們孕育了地球上很大一部分的生物多樣性。)
Deforestation disrupts the regional biogeochemical cycle, weakening topsoil mineralization and carbon storage. (砍伐森林會破壞區域生物地球化學循環，削弱表土礦化作用與碳儲存能力。)
A meticulous biographer analyzed primary letters to reconstruct the psychological developments of the realist painter. (一位細心的傳記作者分析了一手書信，以重塑這位寫實主義畫家的心理發展歷程。)
A meticulous biographer analyzed primary letters to compile a comprehensive biography tracing the painter's shift toward naturalism. (一位細心的傳記作者分析第一手書信，編寫詳盡傳記，記錄畫家轉向自然主義的過程。)
The formation of calcareous ooze on the seabed is biologically driven by the skeletal remnants of foraminifera. (這些變化是由生物作用所驅動的。)
An evolutionary biologist tracks genetic mutations across generations to map species diversification. (演化生物學家追蹤跨世代的基因突變，以繪製物種多樣化的圖譜。)
An ecosystem consists of complex interactions between biotic communities and abiotic parameters like rainfall. (生態系統包含生物群落與降雨等非生物參數之間複雜的互動。)
The paper birch is a hardy deciduous tree that marks the transition zone near the cold northern tundra timberline. (紙樺是一種耐寒的落葉樹，標記了靠近寒冷北方凍原林木線的過渡地帶。)
Pterosaur fossils show birdlike skeletal anatomy adapted for powered flight, allowing these animals to rule Mesozoic skies. (翼龍化石呈現出適合動力飛行的鳥類般骨骼構造，讓這些動物稱霸中生代天空。)

meaning: 與生俱來的權利、繼承權
example: The philosopher argued that individual liberty is a fundamental human birthright that no government can justly deny. (這位哲學家論證說，個人自由是人類與生俱來的基本權利，任何政府都無法公正地剝奪。)
The new highway will bisect the small town into two sections. (新公路將把這座小鎮一分為二。)
Certain marine algae utilize gas-filled bladders to keep their photosynthetic structures floating near the sunlit ocean surface. (某些海洋藻類利用充滿氣體的氣囊，使其進行光合作用的構造保持漂浮在陽光充足的海洋表面附近。)
Economists dismissed the sudden drop in retail sales as a temporary blip rather than a long-term trend. (經濟學家將零售額的突然下降視為短暫的變動，而非長期趨勢。)
Communal oneness and social cohesion shared among egalitarian gatherer tribes delivered a psychological sense of subjective bliss. (平等的狩獵採集部落共享社群生活與凝聚力，帶來深刻的心理幸福感。)
Wearing improperly fitted boots during the intense trek caused a painful blister to form on the hiker's heel. (在艱苦的徒步跋涉中穿著不合腳的靴子，導致登山者的腳後跟形成了痛苦的水泡。)
The bloodhound exhibits exceptional olfactory acuity, making it an ideal canine for tracking scent trails across uneven terrains. (尋血獵犬嗅覺極為敏銳，是在崎嶇地形追蹤氣味的理想犬種。)
Hormones secreted by the endocrine organs travel inside the bloodstream to dictate systematic metabolic adjustments. (內分泌器官分泌的荷爾蒙會經由血液循環，調節全身的新陳代謝。)
A marine mammal must periodically breach the ocean surface to expel carbon dioxide through its specialized blowhole. (海洋哺乳動物必須定期突破海面，以便透過其特化的噴氣孔排出二氧化碳。)
The thick layer of subcutaneous blubber protects marine mammals from lethal thermal loss inside frigid polar waters. (厚厚的皮下鯨脂層保護海洋哺乳動物，免受寒冷極地海水中的致命熱量流失。)
Ancestral pueblo builders situated their multi-story stone dwellings deep beneath the protective overhang of a sandstone bluff. (祖先普韋布洛建造者將多層石造居所設在砂岩峭壁的突出岩層下方，藉此獲得保護。)
The chemist isolated a gaseous compound that glowed with a distinct bluish coloration when exposed to electrons. (化學家分離出了一種氣態化合物，當暴露於電子中時，它會發出獨特的微藍色光芒。)
She didn't mean to blurt out the secret during the dinner conversation. (她並不是故意在晚餐談話中脫口而出這個秘密的。)
Despite his aggressive bluster during negotiations, the corporate executive eventually accepted the union's terms. (儘管在談判過程中表現出咄咄逼人的威嚇，這位企業主管最終還是接受了工會的條件。)
Prolonged atmospheric rain dryness shifts across the valley did not bode well for the subsistence crop yields of agrarian dwellers. (山谷長期天氣乾燥，對以農耕維生的居民而言，作物收成恐怕不樂觀。)

meaning: 富礦帶、致富之源、意外好運
example: The sudden surge in global demand for lithium proved to be an economic bonanza for the mining nation. (全球對鋰需求的暴增，證實是該採礦國家經濟上的一大意外財富之源。)
Marine zoologists analyzed the high-velocity propulsion dynamics of bonito schools navigating tidal coastal seaways. (海洋動物學家分析了在潮汐沿海航道中行進的鰹魚群的高速推進動力學。)
A research botanist tracks how variations in stomatal conductance influence carbon dioxide absorption in ferns. (一位研究植物學家追蹤氣孔導度的變異如何影響蕨類植物中的二氧化碳吸收。)
A moving glacier can transport a massive granite boulder miles away from its native rock formation site. (移動的冰河可以將一塊巨大的花崗岩巨石，運送到距離其原生岩石構造地點數英里遠的地方。)
The region enjoyed a bountiful harvest thanks to the favorable weather. (得益於合適的天氣，該地區迎來了豐收。)
He presented a beautiful bouquet of red roses to her on their anniversary. (他在他們的周年紀念日送了一束美麗的紅玫瑰給她。)
A bovine ruminant relies on complex symbiotic gut bacteria to digest rigid cellulose grasses from the steppe. (牛科反芻動物依賴複雜的共生腸道細菌，來消化來自大草原的僵硬纖維素牧草。)
Ancestral Pueblo builders raised multi-story stone dwellings with a compact, boxlike profile. (祖先普韋布洛人建造了多層石造住宅，外形緊湊方正。)
The arrogant executive constantly loved to brag about his high salary and luxurious corporate lifestyle. (這位傲慢的主管總是喜歡吹噓自己的高薪與奢侈的公司生活方式。)
The brant is a migratory coastal goose that nests inside Arctic tundras and travels southward for winter foraging. (黑雁是沿海遷徙鳥類，會在北極苔原築巢，並於冬季南遷覓食。)
The local authorities intervened rapidly to suppress a chaotic brawl outside the sports stadium. (地方當局迅速介入，以鎮壓體育場外一場混亂的鬥毆。)
The midwest plain became the primary industrial agricultural breadbasket of America due to its exceptionally fertile silt topsoils. (中西部平原的粉砂土壤格外肥沃，因此成為美國主要的工業化農業產糧區。)
Deep breathing exercises can help reduce acute anxiety and stress. (深呼吸練習可以幫助減輕急性焦慮和壓力。)

meaning: 布魯斯特 (人名或早期釀酒工匠)
example: The historical geographer traced how the Brewster mercantile monopoly expanded textile outwork networks across the valley. (歷史地理學家追蹤了布魯斯特商業壟斷集團如何跨越山谷，擴張紡織家庭代工網路。)
The comet's coma glowed brightly as solar heat vaporized frozen volatile elements within the stony core. (當太陽熱量蒸發石質核心內冰凍的揮發性元素時，彗星的彗髮明亮地發光。)
Astronomers utilized advanced optical filters to measure the absolute thermal brightness of Jupiter's volcanic satellite moons. (天文學家使用先進的光學濾鏡，測量木星火山衛星的絕對亮度。)
The technological brilliance of the Mayan astronomical calendar allowed them to forecast eclipses with perfect precision. (馬雅天文曆法的技術卓越，使他們能夠以完美的精確度預測日食與月食。)

meaning: 輝煌地；極其聰明地；鮮豔地
example: The comet's luminous coma glowed brilliantly as intense solar heat vaporized frozen volatile compounds in the core. (彗星明亮的彗髮閃耀著光芒，因為強烈的太陽熱使核心中的冰凍揮發性化合物汽化。)
The researcher filled the beaker to the brim with the chemical solution before starting the titration process. (在開始滴定程序之前，研究人員將化學溶液加滿至燒杯的邊緣。)
Isolated landlocked seas experiencing high solar evaporation deposit thick salt layers as brine crystallizes. (經歷強烈太陽蒸發的隔離內陸海，隨著濃鹽水結晶而沉積出厚厚的鹽層。)
Deciduous broadleaf forests dominate temperate zones experiencing moderate precipitation and four distinct seasons. (落葉闊葉林在經歷適度降雨與四季分明的溫帶地區佔據主導地位。)

meaning: 大張印刷品（早期傳單）；側舷齊射
example: Before printing presses were automated, the single-sheet broadside was the primary medium for news dissemination. (在印刷機自動化之前，單張的大張印刷品是新聞傳播的主要媒介。)
The commercialization of Broadway theater reflected the expanding urban leisure industry of early twentieth-century America. (百老匯劇院的商業化，反映了二十世紀初美國擴張中的城市休閒產業。)

meaning: 山丘；山嶺（常用於威爾斯地名）
example: The small cottage was perched high on the grassy bryn, offering a panoramic view of the Welsh countryside. (這間小木屋坐落在綠草如茵的山丘高處，可將威爾斯鄉村的風光盡收眼底。)
Extrusive basalt lava cools rapidly under seabed ocean water, freezing into a porous, bubbly structural texture. (噴出的玄武岩岩漿在海床海洋水下快速冷卻，凝固成一種多孔、充滿氣泡的結構紋理。)
Indigenous gatherer tribes processed wild deer hides utilizing stone scrapers to fashion durable buckskin clothing. (原住民採集部落利用石製刮削器處理野生鹿皮，以製作出耐用的鹿皮服裝。)
The continuous buildup of ice sheets during periods of glaciation triggered a substantial global drop in sea levels. (在冰河作用期間冰原的持續累積，引發了全球海平面的大幅下降。)

Indigenous river dwellers harvested wetland reeds to weave lightweight, cany containers for storing surplus crops. (原住民河岸居民採集濕地蘆葦，編成輕巧的蘆葦狀容器來儲存剩餘農作物。)

The artisan carver utilized obsidian blades to etch delicate mythological narratives into jade amulets. (這位雕刻師利用黑曜石刀片，將精緻的神話故事刻在玉石護身符上。)

meaning: 天然井（尤指猶加敦半島的石灰岩溶洞井）

The university's foundational charter guarantees equal opportunity to all applicants regardless of race, gender, or creed. (該大學的創始憲章保障所有申請者享有平等機會，不論其種族、性別或宗教信條為何。)
The hikers successfully reached the rocky crest of the mountain ridge just as the sun began to rise. (登山客在太陽剛剛升起之時，成功抵達了山脊的岩石頂峰。)
The Cretaceous period concluded with a mass extinction event that wiped out the non-avian dinosaurs. (白堊紀以一場大規模滅絕事件結束，該事件清除了非鳥類的恐龍。)
Lichens can colonize bare granite by anchoring securely inside a microscopic stone crevice. (地衣能透過在微小的石頭裂縫內牢固地錨定，從而拓殖裸露的花崗岩。)
The artisan mixed ground iron oxide minerals to produce a brilliant crimson pigment glaze for decorating the ceremonial earthenware urn. (工匠將磨碎的氧化鐵礦物混合，製成鮮豔的深紅色釉料，用來裝飾儀式用陶甕。)

meaning: 造成嚴重傷害的；令人癱瘓的

meaning: 關鍵地；批判性地；危急地

meaning: 十字軍東征；改革運動；奮鬥
example: The environmental organization launched a global crusade to eliminate single-use plastics from major oceans. (該環境組織發起了一項全球運動，旨在從各大洋中消除一次性塑膠。)
Crustal deformation occurs at tectonic plate boundaries due to the intense pressure of moving plates. (地殼變形發生在板塊交界處，這是由於移動板塊的強烈壓力所造成的。)
Igneous rocks have a crystalline texture that forms as molten magma cools and solidifies beneath Earth's surface. (火成岩具有結晶狀紋理，這種紋理是在熔融岩漿於地表下冷卻凝固時形成的。)
Her vague ideas began to crystallize into a concrete business plan. (她模糊的想法開始形成一個明確的商業計畫。)
A bovine ruminant continuously chews its cud to facilitate the bacterial breakdown of rigid plant cellulose. (牛科反芻動物不斷地咀嚼牠的反芻食物，以促進細菌分解僵硬的植物纖維素。)
The investigation concluded that the manager was culpable for the leak. (調查得出結論，經理對這次洩漏事件負有責任。)
The historic landmark is regarded as a culturally significant site that must be preserved for future generations. (這處歷史地標在文化上具有重要意義，必須保存給後代子孫。)

Sumerian scribes developed cuneiform writing, pressing wedge-shaped stencils into wet clay tablets. (蘇美書吏發展出楔形文字，並以楔形筆在潮濕的泥板上壓印文字。)

meaning: （博物館、美術館等的）館長；策展人

The eccentric collector filled his study with rare curios gathered from his travels across East Asia. (這位古怪的收藏家在書房裡擺滿了他東亞之行中所收集到的稀有古玩。)
The young dancer made a polite curtsy to the audience after the show. (年輕的舞者在演出結束後向觀眾行了禮貌的屈膝禮。)
Marine biologists observed that specific blue-green alga blooms reflect a distinct cyan wavelength under sunlight. (海洋生物學家觀察到，特定的藍綠藻大量增殖在陽光下會反射出獨特的青色波長。)
Cyclic changes in Earth's orbital eccentricity drive long-term glacial cycles across geological eras. (地球軌道離心率的週期性變化，驅動了地質時代長期的冰期循環。)
Early phonographs relied on a rotating cylindrical tinfoil sleeve to capture and reproduce acoustic vibrations. (早期留聲機使用旋轉的圓柱形錫箔套筒，捕捉並重現聲波振動。)

meaning: 銀版攝影法（早期攝影術）

Thick overcast clouds can significantly dampen solar radiation levels, decreasing daily photosynthetic output in ferns. (濃厚的陰雲會顯著降低太陽輻射，減少蕨類植物每日的光合作用。)

meaning: 阻尼器；減震器；抑制因素
example: Persistent overirrigation deposits toxic alkali minerals, acting as a direct economic damper on crop maturation phases. (持續過度灌溉會沉積有毒鹼性礦物，直接抑制作物成熟。)
The dandelion utilizes wind-assisted dispersal, with its lightweight seed tufts traveling miles away from the parent plant. (蒲公英利用風力輔助的散播方式，其輕量的種子絨毛能傳播到距離親代植物數英里遠的地方。)
Dense forest foliage dapples incoming sunlight, creating dim, patchy light on the forest understory. (茂密的森林枝葉讓射入的陽光變得斑駁，在林下形成微弱的明暗光點。)
Massive atmospheric injections of volcanic ash can drastically darken the sky, blocking solar rays for consecutive months. (大量火山灰噴入大氣，會使天空迅速變暗，連續數月遮蔽陽光。)
Deep ocean cave dwellers adapt to absolute darkness by losing functional eyes and developing tactile organs. (深海洞穴居民透過失去功能性的眼睛並發展觸覺器官，來適應絕對的黑暗。)
In times of economic hardship, families would carefully darn worn clothing rather than purchasing new garments. (在經濟艱難的時期，家庭會仔細地織補破舊的衣物，而不是購買新的衣服。)
The journalist filed the report from Tokyo with a Monday dateline. (記者從東京發回了這篇帶有週一日期欄的報導。)

The diamond ring gave off a dazzling reflection under the spotlight. (鑽石戒指在聚光燈下發出耀眼的光芒。)
The young pianist performed the intricate concerto dazzlingly, earning a standing ovation from the audience. (這位年輕鋼琴家將複雜的協奏曲演奏得精彩絕倫，贏得全場起立鼓掌。)
The current economic crisis has caused a severe dearth of employment opportunities for recent university graduates. (當前經濟危機導致剛畢業的大學生面臨嚴重的就業機會短缺。)
The global bank implemented a structural relief program to assist impoverished debtor nations during the recession. (全球銀行實施了一項結構性救濟計畫，以在經濟衰退期間協助貧困的債務國。)
The lifestyle of the late empire was seen as overly decadent. (帝國晚期的生活方式被認為是過度頹廢的。)
The geometric pattern on the moth's wing acts as an evolutionary deception designed to confuse predatory birds. (蛾類翅膀上的幾何圖案是一種演化出的偽裝，能迷惑掠食性鳥類。)
The marketing campaign was penalized for its highly deceptive claims regarding the health benefits of the supplement. (該行銷活動因其對補充劑健康益處的高度欺騙性宣稱而受到處罰。)
A deciduous forest experiences seasonal dormancy, with trees shedding leaves during autumn to conserve vital fluids. (落葉林經歷季節性休眠，樹木在秋季落葉以保存至關重要的水分。)

meaning: 裝飾藝術風格 (Art Deco 的簡稱)
example: The Art Deco movement utilized bold geometric shapes and streamlined designs in urban architecture. (裝飾藝術運動在城市建築中利用了前衛的幾何形狀和流線型設計。)
Anaerobic bacteria decompose organic matter in waterlogged wetlands, releasing heavy amounts of methane gas. (厭氧細菌在積水的濕地中分解有機物，釋放出大量的甲烷氣體。)
Fungi and microscopic bacteria fuel the decomposition process, returning organic elements back to the forest soil. (真菌和微小細菌驅動著分解過程，將有機元素帶回到森林土壤中。)
The biological study observed how the animals defecate to mark territory. (這項生物學研究觀察了動物如何排便以標記領地。)

meaning: 無防備的；無自衛能力的
example: Avian nestlings are born defenseless, relying entirely on continuous parental incubation and predator distraction. (雛鳥出生時毫無防備，完全仰賴親鳥孵育與引開掠食者。)

Under immense tectonic stress, rocks can plastically deform rather than fracturing cleanly. (在巨大的板塊壓力下，岩石會發生塑性變形，而非乾脆地斷裂。)
The artisan carver demonstrated deft handling, engraving detailed geometric motifs into flat limestone slabs without structural cracking. (這位雕刻師展現了靈巧的手藝，在平坦的石灰岩厚板上雕刻出詳細的幾何圖案而未發生結構性龜裂。)

Overgrazing by pastoral herds destroys pioneer root stabilization systems, accelerating severe topsoil erosion and landscape degradation. (牧群過度放牧會破壞先驅植物的固土根系，加劇嚴重的表土侵蝕與地景惡化。)
Arid atmospheric dryness can swiftly dehydrate vulnerable amphibian skin cells unless they secrete protective mucus. (乾燥的大氣可能迅速使脆弱的兩棲動物皮膚細胞脫水，除非牠們分泌保護性黏液。)
The ancestral pueblo shaman invoked a powerful supernatural deity to bring rainwater to their semiarid farmlands. (祖先普韋布洛薩滿祈求強大的超自然神祇，為他們半乾旱的農地帶來雨水。)
The culinary arts institute prepared an array of delectable desserts for the annual fundraising gala. (烹飪藝術學院為年度募款晚宴準備了一系列美味可口的甜點。)
Stratigraphic surveys help delineate the precise geological boundary markers separating the Mesozoic and Cenozoic eras. (地層調查有助於描繪中生代與新生代之間精確的地質界線。)
Social workers argue that poverty and lack of education are primary factors contributing to juvenile delinquency. (社工認為，貧困和缺乏教育是導致青少年犯罪的主要因素。)
The patient suffered from severe delirium due to a high fever, failing to recognize family members. (患者因高燒而嚴重神智不清，無法認出家人。)
A river delta forms when sediment-laden river water enters a stagnant ocean basin, slowing down and dropping its load. (載滿沉積物的河水流入平靜的海盆後，水流減速並沉積所挾帶的物質，逐漸形成河口三角洲。)

International leaders gathered to deplore the violent acts of terrorism. (國際領導人聚集在一起譴責恐怖主義的暴力行為。)
The revolutionary military council voted to depose the tyrannical dictator and establish a provisional government. (革命軍事委員會投票決定廢黜暴虐的獨裁者，並建立臨時政府。)
River delta formations are driven by the persistent deposition of silt transported from highland mountain regions. (河流三角洲的形成是由從高山山區運送過來的粉砂持續沉積所驅動的。)
Each depositor is protected up to a specific limit by government-backed bank insurance programs. (每位存款人都享有政府支持的銀行保險保障，金額上限依規定而定。)
Aristocratic art connoisseurs would often deprecate modernist woodcuts, viewing them as cheap, crude, and non-naturalistic formats. (貴族藝術行家經常輕視現代主義木刻版畫，將其視為廉價、粗糙且非自然主義的形式。)

The invading soldiers proceeded to despoil the ancient temples of their treasures. (入侵的士兵開始掠奪古代寺廟的寶藏。)

The devout followers gathered at the sacred temple every dawn to offer traditional morning prayers. (虔誠的信徒們每到黎明都會聚集在神聖的寺廟裡，進行傳統的晨禱。)

Ancestral Pueblo potters decorated earthenware jars with sharp diagonal lines etched using bone fragments. (祖先普韋布洛陶工用骨片刻出銳利的斜線，裝飾陶罐。)
The sociological essay explores the false dichotomy between traditional agrarian lifestyles and modern urban existence. (這篇社會學文章探討了傳統農業生活方式與現代城市存在之間的錯誤二分法。)
The actor's clear diction and precise vocal articulation ensured that every word reached the back of the theater. (演員咬字清晰、發音精確，確保劇場最後方的觀眾也能聽清每個字。)
The company offers a differential pay scale based on years of experience. (公司依照工作年資提供差別薪資制度。)

meaning: 擴散；傳播（動詞第三人稱單數）

Ruminants possess a specialized digestive tract containing symbiotic bacteria to break down rigid plant cellulose. (反芻動物擁有特化的消化道，內含共生細菌以分解僵硬的植物纖維素。)
The historical library launched an ambitious initiative to digitize millions of rare, decaying manuscripts. (這座歷史圖書館啟動了一項雄心勃勃的計畫，將數百萬份珍稀且日漸脆化的手稿數位化。)
The university chose to dignify the event by inviting three world-renowned Nobel laureates as speakers. (該大學選擇邀請三位享譽世界的諾貝爾獎得主擔任講者，以增添這場活動的尊榮。)

The famous Hollywood celebrity arrived with a large entourage of bodyguards. (這位好萊塢知名人士抵達時，身邊有一大群隨行人員與保鑣。)

Living in the subzero arctic regions served to enure the indigenous hunters to extreme weather hazards. (居住在低於零度的北極地區，使當地的獵人適應了極端的天氣災害。)

The historical emperor acquired the famous epithet 'the Great' following his decisive military triumphs. (這位歷史上的皇帝在其決定性的軍事勝利後，獲得了著名的別稱「大帝」。)

The Cenozoic era saw a massive radiation of complex eukaryotic organisms, occupying newly emptied post-extinction biological niches. (新生代見證了複雜真核生物的大規模輻射演化，牠們佔據了滅絕後新出現的生態棲位。)

meaning: 真社會性的（如螞蟻、蜜蜂）
example: Ant colonies represent a eusocial structure characterized by reproductive division of labor and cooperative brood care. (蟻群代表了一種真社會性結構，以繁殖分工與合作照顧幼雛為特徵。)

meaning: 稍縱即逝的；短暫的 (同 ephemeral)
example: Desert rainfall pulses are highly evanescent, generating sudden watercourses that dry out quickly. (沙漠的降雨脈衝極為短暫，形成的水道來得快、乾得也快。)
The quality of the manufactured textile is evaluated based on the absolute evenness of its weaving pattern. (製造的紡織品品質是根據其編織圖案的絕對均勻度來評估的。)

The report criticized the administration for spending excessively on bureaucratic infrastructure rather than direct public services. (該報告批評行政部門在官僚基礎設施上花費過度，而非用於直接的公共服務。)
A marine mammal's flippers contain a countercurrent heat exchanger that prevents dangerous hypothermia. (海洋哺乳動物的鰭狀肢包含一個逆流熱交換器，可防止危險的失溫。)
The medical surgeon operated carefully to excise the malignant tumor from the patient's liver. (外科醫生小心翼翼地進行手術，以切除患者肝臟中的惡性腫瘤。)

example: The polar expedition traversed a vast, featureless landscape of pure white snow and ice for weeks. (極地探險隊花了數週時間，穿越一望無際、只有純白冰雪的平坦地帶。)
The post-glacial thaw transformed the frozen steppe plain into a highly fecund, fertile livable agricultural valley. (冰河期後融冰將冰凍的大草原轉變成肥沃且適合農耕的谷地。)
The Whig party leaders aligned with federalist political guidelines, drafting infrastructure bills to fund Midwest transcontinental railways. (輝格黨領袖依循聯邦主義的政治方針，起草基礎設施法案以資助中西部橫貫大陸鐵路。)
The student decided to feign illness to avoid taking the difficult test. (這名學生決定裝病以避免參加困難的考試。)

meaning: 抵擋；供養（常與 fend for oneself 連用）
example: Altricial avian hatchlings cannot fend for themselves inside the open forest understory canopy, requiring continuous parent care. (晚熟型的鳥類雛鳥在開闊的林下無法自力更生，需要親鳥持續照顧。)
Yeast is used to ferment sugar into alcohol during beer production. (在啤酒生產過程中，酵母被用來將糖發酵成酒精。)
A fern reproduces via spores rather than seeds, thriving in damp, shaded forest understories. (蕨類植物透過孢子而非種子進行繁殖，在潮濕、陰暗的森林底層茂盛生長。)
Marine invertebrates rely on synchronized spawning to maximize the probability of successful external egg fertilization. (海洋無脊椎動物依賴同步產卵，以最大化外部卵子成功受精的機率。)
The political activist spoke with an intense fervor that deeply inspired the gathered assembly. (政治活動家以強烈的熱情發言，深深激勵了聚集在一起的集會群眾。)
Medical biologists monitor the mammalian fetus inside the womb to trace early cranial and skeletal maturation phases. (醫學生物學家監測子宮內的哺乳動物胎兒，以追蹤早期的顱骨與骨骼成熟階段。)
The satiric writer drafted a fictional kingdom to mask critiques aimed at the ruling aristocratic administration. (這位諷刺作家虛構了一個王國，以掩飾針對統治貴族行政當局的批判。)

meaning: 野石；散石（天然建築石材）
example: Pioneer colonists constructed sturdy agricultural homesteads using unshaped fieldstone cleared from their fields. (拓荒殖民者利用從田裡清出的未加工野石，建造堅固的農莊。)
The political candidate delivered a fiery speech that ignited passion and enthusiasm among his supporters. (這位政治候選人發表了一篇慷慨激昂的演講，點燃了支持者的熱情。)
Neolithic cave artwork transitioned from abstract lines toward figural depictions that clearly mapped hunting groups and bisons. (新石器時代的洞穴藝術品從抽象線條過渡到具象的描繪，清晰映射出狩獵群體與野牛。)
Neolithic artwork transitioned toward figurative styles that explicitly depicted human hunting groups and animals. (新石器時代的藝術品轉向具象風格，明確描繪了人類狩獵群體與動物。)
The oral storyteller utilized narrative metaphors figuratively to convey complex tribal legal systems to children. (口頭說故事者形象化地利用敘事隱喻，向兒童傳達複雜的部落法律制度。)
Paleolithic cultures crafted small clay figurines that likely carried symbolic or ritualistic significance. (舊石器時代文化製作了小型陶土雕像，可能具有象徵或儀式意義。)
Thomas Edison experimented with thousands of materials before discovering that a carbonized bamboo filament worked efficiently in lightbulbs. (湯瑪斯·愛迪生在發現碳化竹絲能在燈泡中有效運作之前，曾對數千種材料進行過實驗。)
In many Asian cultures, filial piety is regarded as a fundamental virtue. (在許多亞洲文化中，孝道被視為一種基本的傳統美德。)
The early film pioneer was a creative filmmaker who utilized cinematic projectors to display animated sequences to public crowds. (早期電影先驅是一位富有創意的電影製作者，他利用放映機向觀眾播放動畫片段。)
A filmy layer of morning mist hung low over the surface of the lake, obscuring the distant shoreline. (薄薄一層如膜般的晨霧低低地懸掛在湖面上，遮蔽了遙遠的海岸線。)
The private turnpike projects were financially unsustainable without persistent state intervention and subsidies. (如果沒有國家持續的干預和補貼，私營的收費公路計畫在財政上是無法永續的。)
Each island finch population adapted its beak structure to exploit distinct seeds, avoiding direct competition. (每個島嶼上的雀鳥群體都調整了其喙部結構以利用不同的種子，從而避免了直接競爭。)
Music historians analyze the wear on the ebony fingerboard of ancient lutes to understand historical playing techniques. (音樂歷史學家分析古代魯特琴烏木指板上的磨損，以了解歷史上的演奏技巧。)
The introduction of the mechanized firearm transformed inter-tribal warfare configurations across preindustrial territories. (機械化槍械的引進，改變了工業化前領地內跨部落戰爭的格局。)
The glowing meteoric fireball split across the nighttime sky, leaving an identifiable path recorded by astronomers. (發光的隕石火球劃破夜空，留下了一條被天文學家記錄下來的可識別路徑。)
The chemical vitrification of stoneware clay glaze happens during the high-temperature firing phase inside airtight kilns. (炻器黏土釉料的化學玻璃化，發生在密閉窯內的高溫燒製階段。)
The ancestral pueblo dwellings were anchored firmly into the steep sandstone cliffs for strategic military defense. (祖先普韋布洛人的居所牢牢固定在陡峭的砂岩峭壁上，以作為戰略防禦。)
As layers of annual snowfall accumulate and compress, snow recrystallizes into a dense intermediate state called firn. (隨著每年降雪層的累積和壓縮，雪會重新結晶成一種稱為粒雪的緻密中間狀態。)
The military garrison erected a tall cedar flagpole inside the center of the frontier fortress complex. (衛戍部隊在邊境堡壘建築群中央豎立了一根高大的雪松木旗桿。)
The young fashion designer has a unique flair for combining modern street styles with traditional textiles. (這位年輕的服裝設計師在將現代街頭風格與傳統紡織品相結合方面，有著獨特的天賦。)
During the freezing winter months, wearing a heavy flannel shirt helps retain body heat effectively. (在寒冷的冬季，穿著厚實的法蘭絨襯衫有助於有效保持體溫。)
The chemist utilized an airtight glass flask to isolate volatile gases released during putrefaction. (化學家利用一個密閉的玻璃燒瓶，來分離腐爛過程中釋放出的揮發性氣體。)

meaning: 平底船（內河航運大木船）
example: Before steamboats expanded across the midcontinent, merchants manually steered heavily laden flatboat models down rivers. (中部大陸的汽船尚未普及前，商人會駕駛載滿貨物的平底船順流而下。)
Neolithic craftspeople cultivated flax, processing the plant's fibrous stems to weave the earliest linen textiles. (新石器時代的手工藝人耕作亞麻，處理該植物的纖維莖以編織出最早的亞麻織品。)
Nomadic pastoralist communities migrate flexibly across the semiarid steppe landscape according to seasonal rain variations. (游牧畜牧社群會根據季節降雨變化，靈活地在半乾旱草原間遷徙。)
Paleolithic toolmakers utilized bone tools to knap raw flint blocks into sharp symmetrical scraping shards. (舊石器時代的工具製造者，利用骨製工具將原始燧石塊敲擊成鋒利的對稱刮削碎片。)

meaning: 鰭足；（海豹、海龜等的）鰭狀肢
example: The evolutionary transition from a walking limb to a swimming flipper allowed marine mammals to exploit ocean niches. (從步行肢到游泳鰭狀肢的演化轉變，使得海洋哺乳動物能夠利用海洋生態棲位。)
Persistent river overflow events deposit fertile silt layers across the flat agricultural floodplain biome. (河流持續氾濫，將肥沃粉砂沉積在平坦的農業洪泛平原上。)
The recurring floral motif embroidered on the linen chapbook cover suggests a cultural reverence for spring. (繡在亞麻小書封套上反覆出現的花卉圖案，顯示人們對春天懷有文化上的敬意。)
The professional florist sourced rare exotic orchids from international nurseries for the botanical exhibition. (專業花商從國際溫室中採購罕見的外來蘭花，用於植物展覽。)
Orchid horticulturists utilize rich planting compost layers inside each stylized flowerbed to attract specialized insect pollinators. (蘭花園藝家會在每個造型別致的花壇中鋪設肥沃的栽培土，以吸引特定昆蟲授粉者。)
The botanist arranged several experimental seedlings in separate clay flowerpots within the temperature-controlled nursery. (植物學家將幾株實驗幼苗分別種在溫控苗圃中的陶盆裡。)
Homeowners must clean the chimney flue regularly to prevent dangerous accumulations of flammable creosote. (屋主必須定期清理煙囪煙道，以防危險的易燃雜酚油堆積。)
Avian hatchlings inside cold polar tundras are covered in dense fluffy down feathers to insulate their core metabolic warmth. (生活在寒冷極地的雛鳥覆蓋著濃密蓬鬆的絨羽，以保暖並維持體溫。)
The discovery of the pristine fossil bed was a complete fluke driven by unexpected highway construction. (這處原始化石層的發現完全是一個僥倖，是由意外的公路建設所促成的。)
The tech industry is currently in a state of constant flux due to rapid advancements in artificial intelligence. (由於人工智慧的飛速發展，科技產業目前正處於不斷變遷的狀態。)

meaning: 微不足道之物；蠅點；污點
example: Under powerful optical microscopy, the primitive chondrule inclusion inside the meteorite appeared as a mere flyspeck. (在強大的光學顯微鏡下，隕石內部的原始球粒內含物看起來只不過是一個微不足道的蠅點。)
The Mississippi flyway is a critical geographical route for millions of migratory birds traveling across North America. (密西西比遷徙路線是數百萬隻穿梭於北美洲的候鳥至關重要的地理路線。)
Economic growth remains the focal point of the government’s presentation. (經濟成長仍是政府報告的核心焦點。)
The campaign aims to focalize public attention on climate change. (該活動旨在將大眾的注意力集中在氣候變遷上。)
Pastoralist communities gathered wild steppe grasses to store as winter fodder for their domesticated livestock herds. (畜牧社群採集野生大草原牧草，以儲存作為其馴養牲畜獸群的冬季飼料。)
Herbivorous Mesozoic dinosaurs consumed prodigious volumes of dense gymnosperm foliage daily to survive. (中生代食草恐龍每天需要大量茂密的裸子植物葉片維生。)
The academic journal published a comprehensive analysis of the folkloric traditions of the Appalachian region. (該學術期刊發表了一篇對阿帕拉契地區民俗傳統的全面分析。)
Building a massive coastal resort on a rapidly eroding shoreline was ultimately recognized as an economic folly. (在快速侵蝕的海岸線上建造巨大的海岸度假村，最終被公認為一項經濟上的愚蠢行為。)
Acorns functioned as a vital historical foodstuff for indigenous Californian tribes, who ground them into dense flour. (橡實曾是加州原住民族群重要的食物，他們會將橡實磨成細粉。)

meaning: 山腳下的小丘；丘陵地帶
example: Ancestral Pueblo builders situated their multi-story stone villages near fertile foothills along the canyon. (祖先普韋布洛人將多層石造村落建在肥沃的峽谷山麓附近。)
Fossilized footprints yield clues regarding the walking posture, speed, and weight of extinct organisms. (化石足跡為滅絕生物的行走姿勢、速度和重量提供了線索。)
An individual ant functions as an active forager, secreting specialized trail pheromones once a food resource is pinpointed. (螞蟻一旦找到食物來源，就會分泌特化的路徑費洛蒙。)
The fossilized shells of marine foraminifera settle onto the seafloor, generating thick layers of calcareous ooze. (海洋有孔蟲的化石外殼沉降到海床上，產生厚厚的鈣質軟泥層。)
The technology giant made a successful foray into the automotive market by developing smart vehicle software. (這家科技巨頭透過開發智慧車輛軟體，成功涉足汽車市場。)

meaning: 有力的、強有力的、有說服力的
example: The environmental activist delivered a forceful argument that compelled the city council to ban single-use plastics. (環境活動家發表了強有力的論證，迫使市議會禁止一次性塑膠。)
The mercantile caravan had to locate a shallow gravel river zone to safely ford their heavily laden horse carts. (商隊必須找到淺而多石的河段，才能安全地讓滿載貨物的馬車涉水而過。)
The constitutional scholars analyzed the original political philosophies articulated by the nation's founding forefathers. (憲法學者分析了開國先賢所闡述的原始政治理念。)
The comparative anatomy study detailed the evolutionary adaptation of the whale's forelimb into a flipper. (這項比較解剖學研究詳細描述了鯨魚前肢演化為鰭狀肢的適應性過程。)

meaning: 縮短透視；用透視法縮短

The government forester monitored old-growth timberline reserves to assess how climatic variations altered broadleaf seed outputs. (政府林務員監測原始林線附近的保護區，以評估氣候變化如何影響闊葉樹的種子產量。)

The founding of the Iroquois Confederacy formalized legal and organizational agreements across five separate indigenous tribes. (易洛魁聯盟的創立，使五個獨立原住民部落之間的法律與組織協議正式化。)
The fragile shipping container was clearly marked to warn personnel about the extreme fragility of the glass lenses. (易碎品包裝箱上有清楚標示，提醒搬運人員玻璃鏡片極易破損。)
Historians had to reconstruct the ancient legal code based on fragmentary records preserved in different libraries. (歷史學家必須根據保存在不同圖書館中的殘缺記錄，來重建古代法典。)

meaning: 富蘭克林 (歷史人物例：班傑明·富蘭克林)
example: Benjamin Franklin conducted early electromagnetic experiments, adding lawlike regularities to our primitive grasp of physics. (班傑明·富蘭克林進行早期電磁實驗，為人們理解物理學的規律奠定了基礎。)
Because gaseous helium molecules are exceptionally lightweight, they escape freely into the upper layers of the atmosphere. (由於氣態氦分子非常輕，它們會自由逸散到高層大氣中。)

meaning: 大一新生（英式英美語常用）、更清新的

Lichens grow vigorously on freshly cooled basaltic lava rock formations following a volcanic eruption. (火山爆發後，地衣會在新近冷卻的玄武岩上蓬勃生長。)

meaning: 佛洛伊德的；佛洛伊德學派的
example: The Freudian school of psychology emphasizes the psychodynamic influence of suppressed childhood trauma on adult amnesia. (佛洛伊德心理學派強調被壓抑的童年創傷，對成年失憶症所產生的心理動力學影響。)
The historical documentarian highlighted the apparent friendliness between pioneer homesteaders and ancestral pueblo dwellers. (歷史紀錄片工作者強調拓荒農莊居民與祖先普韋布洛居民之間明顯的友好關係。)
The woolly mammoth possessed exceptional anatomical adaptations designed to endure the frigid climate of the Ice Age. (長毛象具備卓越的解剖適應能力，旨在忍受冰河時期的嚴寒氣候。)
The veterinary clinic noted that the puppy became remarkably frisky after recovering from the infection. (獸醫診所注意到，小狗在從感染中康復後，變得異常活潑歡鬧。)
The serious academic environment left very little room for frivolity or unprofessional conduct. (嚴肅的學術環境幾乎沒有給輕浮或不專業的行為留下一點空間。)

meaning: 輕浮的；不重要的；瑣碎的
example: The court dismissed the frivolous lawsuit because it lacked any verifiable legal basis or logical arguments. (法院駁回這起瑣碎的訴訟，因為它缺乏可驗證的法律依據與合理論點。)
Ancient Egyptian wall art emphasized strict frontality, ensuring the chest and eyes always maintained a frontal orientation. (古埃及牆壁藝術強調嚴格的正面性，確保胸部與眼睛始終保持正面的朝向。)

meaning: 正面性 (藝術中的正面描繪)
example: Ancient Egyptian wall reliefs frequently exhibited strict frontality, depicting eyes and shoulders facing forward. (古埃及牆壁浮雕經常表現出嚴格的正面性，將眼睛和肩膀描繪為面向正前方。)

The interdisciplinary symposium was praised for its fruitfulness, yielding several collaborative research grants. (這場跨學科座談會因其富有成效而受到讚譽，產生了數個合作研究資助專案。)
After three weeks of fruitless searching, the maritime rescue team suspended operations in the northern sector. (在經歷了三週徒勞無功的搜尋後，海上救援隊暫停了北區的行動。)

meaning: 富勒 (如富勒土、縮絨工)；更完整的

The pest control professionals had to completely fumigate the apartment building to eradicate the termite infestation. (除蟲專業人員必須對整棟公寓大樓進行全面煙燻消毒，以根除白蟻帶來的危害。)

meaning: 家具、室內陳設（常用複數）
example: The luxury apartment's contemporary furnishings were carefully selected to complement the architectural layout. (這間豪華公寓的當代室內陳設經過精心挑選，以與建築格局相得益彰。)
The Arctic fox has a thick, furry coat that provides exceptional thermal insulation against freezing sub-zero temperatures. (北極狐擁有厚實、毛茸茸的皮毛，能針對零下低溫提供卓越的保暖效果。)
